caveats: ⛑ skill1 full-charge heal is keyed to `shotFired` — the schema has no full-charge trigger. bay is RL (chargeFrames 60), so every trigger pull is treated as a full-charge attack; any partial-charge firing would over-fire this heal.

⛑ `defPct` scales the TARGET's own DEF, but the kit line grants '10.13% of the SKILL USER's DEF'. There is no casterDefPct StatKey; the value is encoded verbatim. defPct is inert for damage in v1, so this mis-scaling moves no number today — it must be revisited if DEF ever feeds an offensive conversion.

⛑ The skill2 heal recovers COVER HP, not unit HP. It is modeled as a self-targeted `heal` (5 ticks / 1s) so the recovery channel exists; whether cover-HP recovery satisfies an on-recovery consumer in game is unverified. bay has no `recovery` trigger and the effect is self-scoped, so it is currently inert either way — do NOT widen its target without a measurement.
⛑ Cadence tuple unverified (datamine-unreliable): ammo 6 / reloadFrames 141 / chargeFrames 60 / hitsPerShot 1. These drive the `shotFired` heal frequency — the only cadence-sensitive block here.

burst is authored as a genuinely effect-free slot: all three burst lines are cover-HP or ally damage-mitigation, neither of which has an offensive channel. 'Damage Taken ▼ 8.87%' targets ALL ALLIES (mitigation), NOT the boss — it is deliberately NOT encoded as `damageTakenPct`, which the schema defines as a boss debuff where positive = boss takes more; encoding an ally-side ▼ there would be a wrong-target model.
'only if self is alive' / 'cover has been destroyed' conditions are scope-trivial or never satisfied at scope lock (immortal allies, boss deals no modeled damage).
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⛑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. bay is RL/Fire/Defender/Burst II — a pure sustain kit with ZERO damage lines in any slot: no flatDamage, no dot, no ATK/crit/core/damage-up buff, no weapon-state modifier, no gauge effect. Modeled: (S1a) own-burst-cast ally DEF buff, continuous/no duration; (S1b) per-full-charge heal to allies except self, kept because heal lines are never skippable on isolation — they fire teammates' `recovery` triggers (e.g. crown-style on-recovery consumers); (S2b) full-burst-end self cover regen as a 5-tick heal. Unmodeled: both damage-share lines (no HP pool at scope lock), the cover-destroyed heal and cover rebuild (cover destruction is never reached — the boss deals no modeled damage), Cover Max HP ▲ (a separate pool from unit Max HP; encoding it as maxHpPct/casterMaxHpPct would falsely feed atkOfMaxHpPct conversions), and the ally Damage Taken ▼ (mitigation, not a boss debuff). Expected sim footprint: bay contributes no self damage and no team damage buff; her only cross-unit channel is the S1b recovery event stream.

flags.reasoning: Kit says 'when performing Full Charge attacks'; TriggerDef has no full-charge kind. bay's base weapon is RL with chargeFrames 60, so in practice every fired round is a full-charge shot and shotFired is 1:1 with full charges. `chargeCounter` was rejected: its per-phase cycling semantics (effects[P] indexed by phase) are wrong for a single unconditional effect.
flags.recipe: Record a bay fight with an on-recovery consumer (crown-style) in the team; count recovery-driven proc popups vs bay's shot count over 180s. Equal counts → shotFired correct. Fewer → partial charges exist and the block needs a full-charge gate. Cheap sim-side pre-check: instrument cfg.onEvent for kind:'shot' with srcSlot=bay and compare against the per-shot cadence implied by chargeFrames 60 + reloadFrames 141 + ammo 6.

flags.reasoning: The kit grants DEF equal to 10.13% of the SKILL USER's DEF (a caster-scaled flat grant, the DEF analogue of casterAtkPct). The schema's only DEF stat is defPct, which scales the TARGET's own DEF — semantically different whenever an ally's DEF differs from bay's. Not fabricating a value; flagging the schema gap. defPct is explicitly inert for damage in v1, so the mis-scaling currently moves nothing.
flags.recipe: No measurement needed while DEF is damage-inert. If a `casterDefPct` StatKey is ever added (mirroring casterAtkPct's flat-resolve-at-apply-time path), re-key this block to it and assert the emitted buffApply value equals 0.1013 × bay's DEF rather than a raw percentage.

Modeled for kit completeness; self-scoped and bay has no recovery trigger, so it is inert today and cannot over-credit anything.

Emitting an empty array is the schema's stated representation for a genuinely effect-free slot; the alternative (encoding Damage Taken ▼ 8.87% as a damageTakenPct buff) would be an actively WRONG model, since that stat is the boss-side debuff channel and a negative ally-scoped value could later be read as a team damage change.
